chapters.title: Sites, Covers, And Descent
chapters.conceptualOwner: Grothendieck coverage and matching-family descent

chapters.title: Sheafification By Cover Completion
chapters.conceptualOwner: free coherent cover completion and the Cat-valued sheaf reflector
chapters.boundary: the constructed reflector is fixed-site and Cat-valued; no arbitrary coefficient category, commutative-ring lift, left exactness, site base-change comparison, classical plus-construction comparison, coverhood decision procedure, or global normalization theorem is claimed

chapters.title: Commutative Algebra By Universal Property
chapters.conceptualOwner: representation-free polynomial extension, one-element localization, and finite cover certificates
chapters.boundary: the active algebra gives universal-property interfaces and selected empty-variable, unit, zero, idempotent, and split-idempotent models; it does not construct polynomial algebras or localizations for arbitrary inputs, choose fraction or monomial syntax, prove a categorical product universal property, identify arbitrary ring packages, or yet construct affine geometry

chapters.title: Affine Geometry And The Sieve $D(f)$
chapters.conceptualOwner: functor-of-points affine geometry with invertibility sieves, localization charts, and the generated big Zariski site
chapters.boundary: basic-open representation and intersection are checked pointwise rather than as whole natural equivalences; the big affine slice and least generated topology are constructed, while commutative-ring sheafification, coordinate locality, and the thin affine-scheme presentation remain assumption-explicit, with no small-site, stalk, qcqs-comparison, or representation-independent scheme theorem

chapters.title: Schemes From Covering Charts
chapters.conceptualOwner: global-first site-relative schemes with constructively generated affine covers and inherited actual overlaps
chapters.boundary: the global object, reflective slice sites, topology-local certificate, affine presentations, basis comparisons, and selected slice product are assumption-explicit; the package is binary and site-relative, with no atlas-first gluing, arbitrary pullback construction, compact-open or classical comparison, scheme-morphism category, or representation-independent scheme theorem

chapters.title: The Projective Line And The Boundary Of Construction
chapters.conceptualOwner: universal-property Laurent coordinates on an actual inherited overlap and the assumption-explicit supplied projective-line boundary
chapters.boundary: the global site-relative scheme, selected actual intersection, common base, polynomial and localization presentations, and whole transition-identity paths are supplied at their stated boundaries; Laurent transition maps are constructed by universal properties, but no atlas-first gluing, closed projective object, projectivity or non-affineness proof, graded ring, homogeneous localization, degree-zero construction, Proj, or general projective space is constructed

chapters.title: Paths And The Groupoidal Shadow
chapters.conceptualOwner: intrinsic Path realization, structured transport, and invertible realization of directed compositor evidence
chapters.boundary: the selected product and path-compositor consumers exhibit computational groupoidal closure and pseudo realization; they do not establish closure for every categorical former, a second equality eliminator, a complete weak omega-groupoid semantics, or a global normalization theorem

chapters.title: The Circle And The Integer Line
chapters.conceptualOwner: computational Circle induction and the universal-cover encode-decode equivalence with successor-localized integers
chapters.boundary: the Circle has judgmental point and dependent loop computation, an explicit Integer loop-space equivalence, monodromy, and selected connectedness/truncation consequences; ordinary ap on the loop remains propositional and no generic HIT declaration compiler or global computational HoTT metatheory is claimed

chapters.title: Free Inversion And Groupoidification
chapters.conceptualOwner: whole mapping properties for concrete and category-indexed free realization of directed cells as paths
chapters.boundary: category-indexed formation, the whole unit and recursor, target-side extension/restriction, arbitrary-target mapping equivalence, compositor, and WalkingArrow-Interval recovery are active; source action, Groupoidify_func, its adjunction with Path_cat_func, and post-generic simplex regressions remain deferred

chapters.title: Laxity, Interchange, And The Gray Direction
chapters.conceptualOwner: whole internal laxity action, strict-object profiles, and the selected right-closed walking-square interchanger
chapters.boundary: the active construction is one profiled strict-object/lax-arrow right closure with a derived walking square and oriented interchanger; it does not provide the mirror closure, full Crans-Gray biclosed monoidal structure, tensor functoriality or coherence, or global migration of historical strict endpoint cuts

appendix.title: Formal Presentation Of Functorial Type Theory
